title: On Fubini type theorems for the Riemann integral
summary: One of the essential questions of the theory of multidimensional integrals concerns the evaluation of integrals taken in given domains. In the simplest case, when integrating over parallelepipeds, evaluation can easily be performed by repeated integration. In the case of the Lebesgue integral, the question is easily solvable by Fubini's theorem. In the case of the Riemann integral, the situation is complicated by the difference between Jordan and Lebesgue measures.
